name: Blade Master
description: This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

name: Blade Shield
description: A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.

name: Deadly Blade
description: A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!

name: Devastating Charge
description: Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.

name: Full Plate Armour
description: Full-Plate armour protects the wearer from head-to-foot. Many such suits are blessed or imbued with arcane abilities.

name: Scarred Veteran
description: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.

name: Tenacity
description: This one will not go down easily - it will be necessary to break both the will and the body first.

name: Wound-Maker
description: Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.

name: Artillery Master
description: Those in command of ordnance can potentially decide a battle before the melee has even begun.

description: "If we die, we will die wielding our swords, for there is no better death for a warrior."

name: Majestic Enforcer
description: Thanks to Karl Franz's tireless efforts on behalf of his people, the Empire has flourished during his reign as never before.

name: An Emperor's Journey
description: Although Karl Franz walks a path many have trodden before, few - if any - have done so with such perfection and grace.

name: Foe-Seeker
description: From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.

name: Hard to Hit
description: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

name: Inspiring Presence
description: There are Lords that radiate power, confidence and fear, inspiring their followers to great or terrible acts.

name: Alert
description: Countless conflicts and a keen sense of awareness have made this Lord difficult to entrap.

name: Irrepressible
description: It is said that Sigmar would bear a mortal wound and carry on fighting; this champion follows the hallowed Warrior-God.

name: Lightning Strike
description: "The time to strike is now!"

name: Route Marcher
description: Those who know the land and its secrets will travel faster and further than the foes who don't.

name: Sigmar’s Ward
description: The relentless drive and fury of the Hammer, harnessed for the protection of this ward’s bearer.

name: Fervent
description: Through our acts, the gods will cleanse the lands.

name: Headhunter
description: "Ever thought about joining the Elector's troops, chief? You'd make a good soldier alright."

name: Iron Disciplinarian
description: This Lord expects utter obedience from the smallfolk, and has little time for insurrections or petty revolts.

name: Leader of Renown
description: Revered by the masses, such a celebrated leader will inspire many new recruits.

name: Logistician
description: Proficient with figures, this Lord, or his subordinates, can keep his army fulfilled, even in dire circumstances.

name: Quartermaster
description: A good quartermaster can ration equipment and foodstuffs efficiently, making supplies last longer.

name: Barded Warhorse
description: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

name: Deathclaw
description: The bond between Franz and Deathclaw - the mightiest of Imperial Griffons - is legendary.

name: Imperial Pegasus
description: The Emperor has oft ridden a majestic Imperial pegasus in battle.

name: Leader of Men
description: Franz is a sterling leader beloved by many, who can inspire not just those close, but all men.
